doctrine: Venue support produces a price. Promotion evidence decides whether that price may be bet. This policy never changes Truth Gate status.
freeze_record: The git commit that adds this file is the freeze record. Any edit requires NFL_VENUE_POLICY_V2.
not_retroactive: SF at LA, Melbourne Cricket Ground, kickoff 2026-09-11T00:35:00Z, stays VENUE_EXCLUDED under the prior behavior.

sensitivity.rule: Price each side at hfa=neutral_hfa_points and at hfa=residual_share*M2_HFA_PRIOR. If the sign of (Model_P - no-vig P) differs between the two, block VENUE_SENSITIVITY.

travel.m2_consumption: Only fields already in the frozen M2 feature schema may enter Model_P. Everything else is CONTEXT_ONLY.
